factorRatings.note: Halal-restaurant directory Zabihah (4.8 from 33 reviews) and local small-business directory Intentionalist both single out this Beacon Hill/Rainier Valley shop's hand-stretched dough and homemade sauce, with diners praising a 'crispy and soft' crust and heavily topped gyro and chicken pies; a few reviewers call the beef pizza inconsistent and the menu limited, and note it isn't aiming at Italian-style standards -- it's Seattle's niche halal pizza option rather than a craft destination.
